# Vendored libraries

Loaded only when a user exports an animation, so they do not slow page loads.

| File | Library | Version | Licence | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pptxgen.bundle.js` | [PptxGenJS](https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS) | 4.0.1 | MIT (`LICENSE-pptxgenjs.txt`) | Building the PowerPoint slide |
| `mp4-muxer.mjs` | [mp4-muxer](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mp4-muxer) | 5.2.2 | MIT (`LICENSE-mp4-muxer.txt`) | Wrapping WebCodecs H.264 frames in an MP4 file |

Both are unmodified copies of the npm packages' `dist`/`build` files.
